snippet.title: American Truck Simulator: Illinois Video Trailer
snippet.description:
The official video trailer for the upcoming Illinois DLC for American Truck Simulator releasing May 14th is here!

From navigating the busy streets of Chicago, with its skyscrapers and intricate road network, to cruising through the state’s vast agricultural heartlands, Illinois offers a rich and varied trucking experience, it won't be long till you're hitting the roads of The Prairie State!

Like what you see? Add the Illinois DLC to your Steam wishlist 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486960/American_Truck_Simulator__Illinois/#game_area_purchase
